subject: Potential LOOIC bug in python version

messages.author: d608d16e15304242
messages.subject: Potential LOOIC bug in python version
parts:
Hi all,

We had been working on some data with the Python (Python 3.7.6 64-bit | Qt 5.9.6 | PyQt5 5.9.2 | Darwin 18.7.0) version of hbayesdm (1.0.1 Installed via pip) and getting negative LOOIC figures out for every model we ran. After running the example gng_m1 data, this was still the case so we checked the R version (HbayesDM version 1.0.2) as a quick sanity check - these were positive as expected.

Having looked into this a little bit, it seems to me that the python version is reporting the elpd_loo as the looic.

See the python extract_ic() output for the example (gng_m1) dataset:

{'looic': -794.3916166223078, 'waic': -793.1815491549396}


And from R:

         Estimate   SE
elpd_loo   -794.3 30.3
p_loo         8.1  1.1
looic      1588.6 60.7

We've switched over to the R version in the meantime (assuming that this is the 'correct' output), but thought we should alert you guys!

Cheers,

Arjun
